brief.text: Names of the RPC methods the server accepts.

content.text: Defined here so the dispatch table in Handler.cpp and the command-line parser table in RPCCall.cpp name each method through the same constant, and cannot drift apart.
Not every method appears in both tables. Whether a method has a command-line form is recorded by
in the dispatch table, and checked against the command-line table by RPCCall_test.
